subject: PLEASE ADD THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION TO REMARKS SECTION OF LTR44
text:
A3883/26 NOTAMN Q) LTAA/QRRCH/IV/BO /W /000/999/3608N03333E004 A) LTAA  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2609021431  C) PERM  E) PLEASE ADD THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION TO REMARKS SECTION OF LTR44 
AKKUYU RESTRICED AREA IN ENR 5.1 
1. CLOSED TO ALL TRAFFIC (IFR/VFR) BELOW 11000 FT AMSL AND CLOSED TO 
ALL VFR TRAFFIC ABOVE 11000 FT AMSL AS WELL, EXCEPT: 
A ) AIRCRAFT OF THE PRESIDENCY OF THE REPUBLIC OF TURKIYE 
B ) FLIGHTS OF THE MINISTER OF ENERGY AND NATURAL RESOURCES 
C ) STATE AIRCRAFT OF THE REPUBLIC OF TURKIYE, AMBULANCE, FIRE 
FIGHTING, SEARCH AND RESCUE (SAR), AND EMERGENCY FLIGHTS 
D ) FLIGHTS APPROVED BY THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY AND NATURAL RESOURCES. 
2. FLIGHTS OF THE MINISTER OF ENERGY AND NATURAL RESOURCES, STATE 
AIRCRAFT REFERRED TO IN PARAGRAPH 1(C ), AND AMBULANCE, FIRE 
FIGHTING, SEARCH AND RESCUE (SAR), AND EMERGENCY FLIGHTS INTENDING 
TO USE THIS RESTRICTED AREA ARE REQUIRED TO INFORM THE COORDINATION 
POINT VIA +90 535 701 18 53. 
3. FLIGHTS OTHER THAN THOSE SPECIFIED IN PARAGRAPH 2 ARE REQUIRED TO 
OBTAIN PERMISSION FROM THE COORDINATION POINT VIA +90 535 701 18 53 
IN ORDER TO USE THIS RESTRICTED AREA. 
4. THE FLIGHT INFORMATION TO BE PROVIDED TO THE COORDINATION POINT 
IS AS FOLLOWS: CALL SIGN, DEPARTURE AERODROME, ESTIMATED TIME OF 
DEPARTURE, DESTINATION AERODROME, ESTIMATED TIME OF END PART 1 OF 2
A3883/26 NOTAMN Q) LTAA/QRRCH/IV/BO /W /000/999/3608N03333E004 A) LTAA  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2609021431  C) PERM  E) ARRIVAL, 
ESTIMATED TIME OF DEPARTURE FROM AKKUYU NPP, AKKUYU NPP DEPARTURE 
POINT COORDINATES, FLIGHT TIME, REGISTRATION, DATE OF FLIGHT, 
PURPOSE OF FLIGHT, PASSENGER AND CABIN CREW INFORMATION NAME/LAST 
NAME/ID. 
5. FLIGHTS REQUIRED TO OBTAIN PERMISSION UNDER PARAGRAPH 3 SHALL 
INDICATE IN THE RMK/SECTION OF ITEM 18 OF THE FLIGHT PLAN THAT SUCH ) 
PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED, INCLUDING THE MEANS THROUGH WHICH THE 
PERMISSION WAS OBTAINED AND THE DATE AND TIME THEREOF. 
REF ENR 5.1-6 END PART 2 OF 2 F) SFC  G) UNL)
